name: 林
objective:
無塵室之構成、恆溫恆溼控制、粉塵控制、過濾系統、環境測定、操作管理、針對電子工業之應用。
Clean room system, temperature and humidity control, particle control, filtering system, testing and measurement, operation and maintenance. This course focuses on the application in the electronic industry.
schedule:
1 Inroduction (3hr)
2~5. Basic Aerosol knolowedeg (12hr)
6~9 Basic Ventilation Theory (12hr)
10. Mid term
11~14 IAQ law, code, and standard (9hr)
15~18 Final project
scorePolicy:
Mid Term 30%
Homework 30%
participation 10%
Final project 30%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

1. Handout provides by the instructor
2. Aerosol Science and Technology, 2nd edition, By W. Hinds, John Willey and Sons., Ltd.
References:
Journal papers from:
1. Aerosol science and technology
2. Aerosol science journal
3. Building and environment journal
4. Environment science and technology Journal
5. Journal of cleaning technology
延伸教學與資源:
● 混成學習 (Blended Learning)
課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。
Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標:
SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）
SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）
SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
